verses.pali: “Dasayime, bhikkhave, dhammā bhāvitā bahulīkatā anuppannā uppajjanti, nāññatra sugatavinayā.
verses.english: “Mendicants, these ten things don’t arise to be developed and cultivated apart from the Holy One’s training.
Right view, right purpose, right speech, right action, right livelihood, right effort, right mindfulness, right immersion, right knowledge, and right freedom.

verses.pali: ime kho, bhikkhave, dasa dhammā bhāvitā bahulīkatā anuppannā uppajjanti, nāññatra sugatavinayā”ti.
verses.english: These are the ten things that don’t arise to be developed and cultivated apart from the Holy One’s training.”
